content.title: Home Mortgage Loans: Purchase, Refi, FHA, VA, ARM
content.text: *"On-Us" Appraisal Offer - Chartway's "On Us" Appraisal Offer (covering up to the first $500 in total appraisal costs for one (1) appraisal. Only available for qualifying first mortgage loans with a minimum loan amount of $250,000. To be eligible, applications must be submitted between March 2 and May 31, 2026, and approved, and the loan must close by August 31 following a completed application submission. This offer applies only to first mortgage loans and is available in Virginia, Utah, North Carolina, and Texas. Chartway membership is required prior to closing. A credit card may be required to cover the cost of the appraisal if the loan does not close. However, if the loan closes successfully, the appraisal fee (up to $500) will be credited back to the borrower on the final loan disclosure. The offer is non-transferable and cannot be combined with other promotions. Borrowers are responsible for any appraisal costs exceeding $500 or the cost of any additional appraisal(s). All loans are subject to credit approval, property eligibility, and program terms. Limit one "On Us" Appraisal Offer per household. Additional restrictions and limitations may apply. "On Us" Appraisal Offer and Terms are subject to change or may be discontinued at any time without notice. Please visit any Chartway branch for current rates, terms, and disclosures or for more details.
